newsitem.title: USA: Fla tobacco trial recesses for weekend, no verdict.
newsitem.headline: Fla tobacco trial recesses for weekend, no verdict.

text.p: The Florida court deciding a wrongful death lawsuit against R.J. Reynolds Tobacco Co recessed for the weekend with no verdict.
Judge Bernard Nachman dismissed the six-member panel on Friday evening with a warning not to talk to anyone about the case and not to discuss it among themselves.
The jury deliberated for nearly two hours Friday after more than five hours of closing arguments. Deliberations were scheduled to resume at 0900 EDT (1300 GMT) Monday.
The jurors were asked to decide whether Reynolds made a dangerous and defective product that caused the death of Jean Connor, a smoker who died in 1995 of lung cancer.
